Customer delivery

Twelve steps from discovery to continuous improvement.

  1. 01

    Discovery

    Business model, people, branches, tools, workflows and growth needs.

  2. 02

    Digital audit

    Website, CRM, ERP, finance, HR, marketing, security and manual work.

  3. 03

    Gap map

    Current state → problem → module → benefit → priority.

  4. 04

    Implementation plan

    Immediate, 30-day, 90-day and future roadmap.

  5. 05

    Business OS setup

    Company, users, roles, CRM, finance and HR foundation.

  6. 06

    Industry setup

    Vertical workflows activated where required.

  7. 07

    Automation

    Repeat work automated after the process is understood.

  8. 08

    AI

    Agents added only after reliable data and permissions exist.

  9. 09

    Growth

    Website, acquisition channels and CRM attribution connected.

  10. 10

    Training

    Owner, admins and employees trained.

  11. 11

    Go live

    Migration, testing, acceptance, backup, monitoring and support.

  12. 12

    Continuous improvement

    Monthly review of usage, sales, marketing, support, AI and automation.

The DigitalBurj standard

What 'better' means here.

10 items

  • 01

    Fewer clicks

    • We measure steps for common SME jobs and keep reducing them
  • 02

    Faster onboarding

    • Customers start without weeks of consulting
  • 03

    Understandable errors

    • Every error says what failed, why, and what fixes it
  • 04

    No duplicate entry

    • Data flows from sales to operations to finance
  • 05

    Mobile-first

    • Approvals, sales and daily tasks work well on a phone
  • 06

    WhatsApp-native

    • Official integrations for owner and customer workflows
  • 07

    AI-native

    • AI sees only authorised data and acts through controlled tools
  • 08

    Transparent pricing

    • You know what's included and what's usage- or project-based
  • 09

    Flexible workflow

    • Operational change never corrupts historical financial records
  • 10

    Local where it matters

    • Country requirements built deliberately as localization modules
